title: Fair Wind Cruises
specs: Snorkel at Kealakekua Bay with Captain Cook Monument and vibrant reefs
Night snorkel with manta rays on Hula Kai vessel
Minimum age 7 or 8 years depending on tour
Not wheelchair accessible; guests must board under own power
Fair Wind II vessel max 90 passengers; Hula Kai max 40 passengers
Private charters available on Capt. Jack vessel and larger boats
includes: Snorkel gear including prescription masks available
blurb: Guests snorkel at multiple locations including Kealakekua Bay, known for vibrant coral reefs and marine life. Tours include plant-based breakfast and lunch, snorkeling gear, and knowledgeable guides sharing Hawaiian history and culture. Private and group tours available on large, stable vessels with safety and environmental care emphasized.
extraNote: Cancellations 24 hours in advance for refund; 72 hours for groups 10+ · No single-use plastic bottles allowed on vessels · Alcohol allowed on private charters; drink responsibly · Tours may be cancelled for safety due to weather with full refund · Keauhou Bay office
